items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: It's the same band. That's Jack McVae... That's Marsha Mayor

ctx.x: Yeah, Huey Long was on this trip. It's the same band. That's Jack McVae; he gave a party for me too when I came back from overseas. That's Marsha Mayor (phonetic spelling).
Of all the little bands that you had over the years, which do you think was the best, musically?
